disclaimer: Sample template for testing the config-driven compliance renderer. Evidence for the listed controls, not a certification.

controls.title: Access decisions are enforced
controls.requirement: Every access request is evaluated and either allowed or denied.
controls.howSatisfied: The PDP renders a decision on every request; denials prove enforcement.

controls.title: Identities are registered and human-attributable
controls.requirement: Agents are approved before acting, and activity ties back to a human.
controls.howSatisfied: Registry approval gates activation; the audit trail attributes requests to a verified human.

controls.title: Everything is logged over the period
controls.requirement: Security-relevant events are logged and retained.
controls.howSatisfied: An append-only audit trail records every request, decision, and token issuance.
